description.zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符。
description.en: The application ID of the user, generated when the application is created in the console. The ID contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length.

description.zh: 查询页码，从1开始，传空默认查询第1页。
description.en: The page number to query, starting from 1. If this parameter is left empty, the first page is queried by default.

description.zh: 每页显示个数，最大支持100，参数为空默认显示个数为50。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100. If this parameter is left empty, the default value is 50.

description.zh: 房间ID，由字母、数字、下划线（_）和小数点（.）组成，最大长度36个字符。
description.en: The room ID, consisting of letters, digits, underscores (_), and periods (.). Maximum length: 36 characters.
